title: England's Euros scorers since 1996
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for England at European Championship finals since Euro 96. Own goals and shoot-out penalties do not count. Lots of players scored once, so any of them fills 10th place.

notes.Gary Lineker: Gary Lineker never scored at a Euros finals.
notes.David Platt: David Platt scored England's only goal at Euro 92, before 1996.
notes.Tony Adams: Tony Adams scored at Euro 88, before 1996.
notes.Simon Kjaer: Simon Kjaer's own goal for England in the 2021 semi-final is not counted.
notes.Michael Owen: Michael Owen scored 2, one in 2000 and one in 2004.

sources: https://compstats.uefa.com/v1/player-ranking?competitionId=3&phase=TOURNAMENT&stats=matches_appearance,goals&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA's own player stats, one call per tournament 1996 to 2024)
checks: England's goals per player from UEFA and goalscorers.csv agree exactly (1996 to 2024). Shearer 7 (5 in 1996, 2 in 2000), Kane 7 (4 in 2020, 3 in 2024), Rooney 6, Lampard 3, Sterling 3, then 2 each for Sheringham, Scholes, Owen and Bellingham, and 16 players on 1 for 10th place.
